_styles.cartoon: Whimsical flat cartoon illustration, bright cheerful colors, clean bold outlines, modern children's picture-book style, ancient Israel. Scene:
_styles.cinematic: Photorealistic still frame from an epic big-budget historical film set in ancient Israel, dramatic golden-hour lighting, shallow depth of field, anamorphic 35mm look, rich color grade. Scene:
_styles.snapshot: Candid amateur 1990s disposable-camera snapshot, harsh on-camera flash, slight motion blur, oversaturated colors, awkward tilted framing, as if a tourist stumbled into ancient Israel. Scene:

_suffix: Everyone modestly dressed: long sleeves, long skirts, high necklines. Jewish setting in ancient Israel. No text, letters or writing anywhere.
_kg: a Jewish high priest in plain white linen robes, white sash and white turban
melech: a surprised man wrapped in a white prayer shawl at a wooden synagogue lectern, behind him a giant board-game path where his game piece is sliding all the way back to the starting square
dirshu: a grand palace at night with its huge doors wide open and warm golden light pouring out, small people happily walking in, ten lanterns hanging along the path
apology: a family dinner table where one man sits with arms crossed turning his face away, while at the doorway another man holds flowers with three friends behind him waving awkwardly
calf: a bearded ancient leader in simple robes on a mountaintop raising his arms and pleading toward dramatic sunlit clouds, far below in the valley a tiny golden calf statue and a crowd
kgama: {kg} sitting behind a stone table with a microphone like a press conference, torches on the walls, curious people raising hands
snap: night in a stone temple courtyard: {kg} yawning with eyes half closed while two energetic young priests in white snap their fingers right next to his face
roast: a festive street procession in ancient Jerusalem: the whole crowd has turned its back on a pompous Jewish high priest (blue robe with a hem of little golden bells, jeweled breastplate with twelve colored stones, tall wound white cloth turban with a gold band on the forehead) and is happily following two humble smiling elderly bearded rabbis in plain robes; the high priest stands alone, arms crossed, offended
happy: young women in long-sleeved, ankle-length, high-necked flowing white dresses dancing in a joyful circle in a lush green vineyard at golden hour, arms fully covered to the wrist
thread: a rugged desert cliff at dawn, a long strip of wool tied to a rock visibly changing color along its length from deep scarlet red at one end to pure snow white at the other, gentle sparkles, no fire
yonah: a grumpy bearded prophet sitting under a withered leafy gourd plant on a hot hill under a blazing sun, a small worm on the plant stem, a huge ancient walled city in the background
rain: a family sitting at a table inside a sukkah hut with a palm-branch roof while heavy rain pours through, soup bowls overflowing with rainwater, everyone dismayed
kick: a man in ancient robes angrily kicking a small wooden hut with a leafy roof on a flat rooftop under an enormous blazing sun
torches: an elderly bearded sage in robes joyfully juggling eight flaming torches at night in a temple courtyard lit by giant golden lamps, crowd cheering, musicians with harps on wide stone steps
clouds: a long line of ancient Israelite families with donkeys walking through the desert, completely surrounded by a giant ring of soft glowing white clouds wrapping around them like a protective blanket
bulls: a long parade of many bulls walking in a line toward the Second Temple of Jerusalem on a hill, a massive flat-topped white-and-gold stone facade with tall columns, surrounded by stone walls
minim: inside a crowded wood-paneled synagogue on the festival of Sukkot: an eight-year-old boy with long curly sidelocks and a small black kippah, white shirt, standing on a wooden bench with one arm stretched out stiffly, aiming a tall green palm frond bundle (with myrtle and willow tied on) at a small black internet router with blinking green lights mounted high on the stone wall, a yellow citron held up in his other hand like a phone, squinting hard with his tongue out in concentration, as if hunting for a signal; behind him a row of bearded men in white prayer shawls all aim their own palm fronds at the same router in unison, and a stern old gabbai with a long white beard glares at the boy over his glasses
atzeres: a kind bearded king in a warm candlelit banquet hall hugging his children at the door as they get ready to leave, the table still set
tablets: a bearded ancient leader on a rocky mountain slope hurling two large blank stone tablets that shatter on the ground, below a crowd dancing around a small golden calf
achnai: inside an ancient study hall, bearded rabbis calmly debating at a table while outside the window a whole carob tree flies through the air and a stream flows uphill
akiva: an old bearded man in ancient robes sitting in the back row of a crowded ancient Jewish study hall with plain stone walls and shelves of scrolls, scratching his head in confusion while a teacher lectures enthusiastically at the front
lev: an open parchment scroll on two wooden rollers being rewound from the end to the beginning, a glowing red heart between the rollers, people dancing in a circle around it
c_beam: a triumphant ancient king in royal robes standing amid the smoking rubble of his own palace, which is torn half down: collapsed walls, a gaping hole in the roof, fallen columns, piles of broken stone; he holds a single wooden beam proudly over his head, huge grin
c_cow: a solemn cow wearing a rough burlap sack as clothing, standing next to an empty feeding trough, looking hungry but determined
c_sailors: ancient sailors on a wooden ship in a huge storm rowing desperately toward a distant shore
c_aharon: a nervous bearded priest very slowly placing one single stone on an unfinished stone altar while glancing at a sundial
c_ark: inside an open golden chest, two whole smooth blank grey stone tablets with rounded tops standing upright next to a neat pile of broken pieces of the same blank tablets, soft light
c_floor: {kg} standing barefoot on a cold marble floor at night, shivering, eyes wide open
